biotools.summary: PinPath enables flexible visualization of (omics) data onto pathways diagrams, allowing users to pinpoint where the relevant changes occur. It supports pathway diagrams from WikiPathways and KEGG, as well as custom GPML and KGML files. Data can be displayed on both native pathway layouts and network representations
biotools.name: PinPath
